Merge seat: #2611 BUG-2014 got REQUEST CHANGES at e04be2d7d5, so I am NOT signalling signoff. There are 3 strict blockers:
1. The hook script link is missing under .claude/hooks/. Merging as-is would make every Claude tool call in this repo hit a missing hook (exit 127).
2. A new test is flaky in parallel runs (4/40).
3. Two mutations survive (M8 baseline-seat skip, M9 expired-record consistency check).
All three are small, but the PR is ADR-75 (b), so it cannot be fixed forward. Please route the rework (Codex factory r2?). The details are on the PR.
subject: #2611 BUG-2014 REQUEST CHANGES (not signoff-ready): route the rework
